title: 第21章 前往大斗魂场第22章 斗魂方式
slug: 斗罗穿成宁荣荣的妹妹一路成神
content_zh:
宁荣荣：“那当然啦！
我敢说你的武魂绝对是独一无二的，足以媲美我们七宝琉璃宗的七宝琉璃塔，不过是咒语奇怪了一点，但是跟你的武魂所带来的价值相比，根本不值一提。”
宁苒苒深以为然的点点头：“就是，所以你根本不用觉得你的武魂有多么难以启齿。”
奥斯卡眨眨眼：“真的是这样吗？”
“哈哈哈……说得好！”
弗兰德哈哈一笑，说：“不错不错，这也同样是我想告诉你们的，武魂的咒语不值一提，反而是你们的武魂本身价值，不然如何担得起我们史莱克学院的怪物之名？”
众人一脸受教了。
弗兰德：“好了，时候不早了，我们准备出发。
接下来你们将开始来到史莱克的第一堂课。
你们每个人都将独立完成自己的课程，别怪我没有事先声明，如果你们做的不够好，那么，不死也要脱层皮。”
弗兰德脚尖一点，凌空一蹿声音洪亮：“大家都跟上我。”
……
———分割线———
索托城，南门——
城内的夜晚比起白天还要热闹喧哗，灯火通明，街道小贩的吆喝声，源源不断的传来。
小舞东看看西逛逛，旁边的宁荣荣也同样兴致勃勃，两个人凑在一起，时不时兴奋大喊一声。
朱竹清目不斜视，亦步亦趋的跟在弗兰德身后。
她一边的戴沐白同样如此，不同于朱竹清的冰冷，戴沐白的身上更加自然。
马红俊目不转睛的瞅着路过的美女，那样子要多猥琐有多猥琐，奥斯卡则一派悠闲的走在队伍中间。
宁苒苒缀在队伍后面，心里在暗暗思忖现在的剧情发展到哪里了。

唐三走在宁苒苒旁边，温声道：“苒苒。”
“嗯？”
宁苒苒抬头看他，不明白唐三想说什么。
唐三：“谢谢你帮我和小舞交了学费。”
宁苒苒笑了笑：“我还以为是什么大事呢。
嘻嘻，小事一桩。”
唐三揉了揉宁苒苒的头顶，“下次让我自己来吧，我有钱的，这些年我靠打铁还有武魂殿的补贴攒了很多。”
宁苒苒一脸不在意：“我不缺钱。
再说了，你不是总说你是我哥哥嘛？那干嘛还分得这么清楚。”
七宝琉璃宗最不缺的就是钱！
唐三温柔的笑了笑：“是是是，你说的都对。”
这件事自己心里清楚就行，没必要辜负宁苒苒的一片好心。
他话风一转：“苒苒有没有什么想买的？难得来一趟索托城，可以趁机好好逛逛。
我给你买。”
宁苒苒看了看周边，眼睛一亮，这个糕点看着挺好看！
最后宁苒苒几乎把那条街都尝了个遍，本来她想自己付款的，不过唐三没给她机会，眼疾手快的就先递了钱。
见状，宁苒苒也不再拒绝。
宁苒苒手上都是小吃，嘴里吃得正开心，一不小心鼻尖就沾到了奶油，小声叫唤了一下旁边的唐三，唐三见状掏出手帕为她细致的擦拭，嘴角的糖渍同样被他仔细擦掉，动作轻柔。
content_en:
Ning Rongrong: "Of course!
I dare say that your martial spirit is absolutely unique, comparable to the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Pagoda of our Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Sect, but the spell is a bit strange, but compared with the value brought by your martial spirit, it is not worth mentioning at all. "
Ning Ranran nodded with deep understanding: "That's right, so you don't have to think that your martial spirit is so unspeakable."
Oscar blinked: "Is that really true?"
"Hahaha...well said!"
Flanders laughed and said, "That's right, that's what I want to tell you. The spell of the martial spirit is not worth mentioning, but the value of your martial spirit itself. Otherwise, how can you bear the name of a monster in our Shrek Academy?"
Everyone looked impressed.
Flanders: "Okay, it's getting late, let's get ready to go.
Next, you will begin your first class at Shrek.
Each of you will complete your own course independently. Don't blame me for not stating in advance that if you don't do well enough, you will have to shed your skin even if you don't die. "
Flanders tiptoed and jumped into the air with a loud voice: "Everyone, follow me."
…
——Separating line————
Soto City, South Gate——
The city is even more lively and noisy at night than during the day, the lights are brightly lit, and the shouts of street vendors can be heard continuously.
Xiao Wu was looking around, and Ning Rongrong next to her was equally excited. The two of them got together and shouted excitedly from time to time.
Zhu Zhuqing followed Flanders step by step without squinting his eyes.
The same goes for Dai Mubai on her side. Different from Zhu Zhuqing's coldness, Dai Mubai's body is more natural.
Ma Hongjun stared at the beautiful woman passing by, looking so vulgar and vulgar, while Oscar walked leisurely in the middle of the group.
Ning Ranran was standing behind the team, secretly wondering where the plot was going now.
Tang San walked beside Ning Ranran and said warmly: "Ranran."
"Huh?"
Ning Ranran looked up at him, not understanding what Tang San wanted to say.
Tang San: "Thank you for helping me and Xiao Wu pay the tuition."
Ning Ranran smiled: "I thought it was some big deal.
Hee hee, it’s a trivial matter. "
Tang San rubbed the top of Ning Ranran's head, "Let me do it myself next time. I'm rich. I've saved a lot from blacksmithing and Spirit Hall subsidies over the years."
Ning Ranran looked unconcerned: "I'm not short of money.
Besides, don’t you always say you are my brother? Then why are they so clearly distinguished? "
The most indispensable thing for Qibao Glazed Sect is money!
Tang San smiled softly: "Yes, yes, everything you said is right."
As long as you know this in your heart, there is no need to live up to Ning Ranran's good intentions.
He changed his tone: "Ranran, is there anything you want to buy? It's rare to come to Soto City, so I can take the opportunity to have a good look around.
I'll buy it for you. "
Ning Ranran looked around and her eyes lit up. This pastry looked very good!
In the end, Ning Ranran tasted almost everything in that street. Originally, she wanted to pay by herself, but Tang San didn't give her a chance and handed over the money first with quick eyes and hands.
Seeing this, Ning Ranran no longer refused.
Ning Ranran had snacks on her hands and was eating happily when she accidentally got cream on the tip of her nose. She called Tang San next to her in a low voice. Upon seeing this, Tang San took out his handkerchief and wiped her carefully. He also carefully wiped off the sugar stains on the corners of her mouth with gentle movements.
